problems.query_text: Why do surgical site infections persist despite sterile protocols?
problems.expert_answer: Communication gaps during handoffs and inconsistent adherence to protocols across shifts cause persistent SSIs, not the protocols themselves.

problems.query_text: Why do microservice deployments fail in the first month?
problems.expert_answer: Distributed transaction management failures and lack of idempotent operations cause cascading failures in microservice deployments.

problems.query_text: Why do students forget 90% of lecture content within a week?
problems.expert_answer: Lack of active recall, spaced repetition, and contextual application causes rapid forgetting of lecture-only content.

problems.query_text: Why do 70% of digital transformation projects fail?
problems.expert_answer: Poor change management, lack of executive sponsorship, and misalignment between IT and business goals drive digital transformation failures.

problems.query_text: Why do carbon offset programs often fail to deliver promised reductions?
problems.expert_answer: Additionality problems, non-permanent sequestration, and lack of verification cause carbon offsets to underdeliver on promised reductions.
